snippet.title: Comet's Wayfaring Odyssey (Trailer 2024)
snippet.description:
Graduation Video Game
School : ISART DIGITAL, the Video Game and 3D Animation / VFX School 

Platform : PC
Engine : Unreal Engine 5.3
Number of players : 1
Genre : 3D Puzzle Adventure

Blast off for a training simulator like no other. Welcome to Nebulon Delta ! An alien planet doubling as coaching grounds where trainee dog Comet will learn to overcome puzzles with his sturdy mecha.

--

Décollage pour un simulateur comme nul autre. Bienvenus sur Nebulon Delta ! Une planète extraterrestre servant également de camp d'entraînement où Comet, le chien volontaire, va apprendre à surmonter des puzzles aidé de son mecha robuste.

Ready to play Comet's Wayfaring Odyssey? Visit https://isart-digital.itch.io/comets

3D Artist Concept | Props | Environnement | Texture | Level Art | Lighting | Graphic Design | VFX : Jeanne ROMAIN
Game Design | User Interface | Tech Design | Production | Narrative Design: Arthur TRELUYER
Game Designer | Lead Tech Sound Designer | Tech Designer: Lucas VAUZOUR
Game Designer | Level Designer | 3C Designer | Narrative Designer : Pierre CRONFALT
Tech Designer (3C | Dialogues | Props | Debug | Transition | Save) : Yang YI
Tech Designer (LDOs) | Level Designer : Quentin GODARD
Music & Sound Design : Adrien Jolly
